response.rationale: MIS-C fits the pandemic context, persistent fever, abdominal pain, rash, conjunctivitis, and high inflammatory markers; Kawasaki disease is less likely due to age and prominent abdominal symptoms.

rejected.why: Lacks joint symptoms and has less specific fever/rash pattern
Age >5 years and prominent abdominal pain favor MIS-C over classic Kawasaki disease
Negative blood cultures and absence of lymphadenopathy/pharyngitis pattern make mononucleosis unlikely
